title: Tumor angiogenesis
desc: Endothelial sprouts growing toward a tumor spheroid in a microfluidic chip; used to study tumor-induced angiogenesis and anti-angiogenic drugs.

title: Live imaging of endothelial sprouting
desc: Time-lapse imaging of human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) sprouting from a microfluidic channel into the 3D hydrogel and forming a vascular network over time.

title: Corneal neovascularization
desc: Ocular angiogenesis-inspired vascular model: sprouting vessels around a circular region, mimicking corneal neovascularization.

title: Perfusable blood vessel
desc: Self-assembled, perfusable microvascular network formed in 3D hydrogel inside the chip.

title: Brain organoid-on-a-chip
desc: Brain organoid-on-a-chip with extensive neurite outgrowth.

title: Axonal outgrowth from a 3D neural spheroid
desc: Human neural progenitor (ReN cell)-derived spheroid cultured in 3D, with axons sprouting radially from the spheroid core. Blue: nuclei; green: neuronal processes.

title: Vascularized tumor spheroid in 3D
desc: 3D fly-through of a confocal reconstruction: perfusable microvessels (green) wrapping around and penetrating a tumor spheroid (red).

title: Vascularized skin
desc: 3D reconstruction of a vascularized skin model with perfusable microvessels beneath the skin layers.

title: Tumor immune microenvironment
desc: Immune cells in a reconstructed tumor immune microenvironment.

title: NK cells attacking a vascularized tumor
desc: Time-lapse confocal imaging of a vascularized colorectal tumor model on a chip. NK cells (white) move through the engineered microvasculature (red) and converge on a colorectal cancer cluster (green), so immune-cell cytotoxicity can be followed in a human-relevant 3D microenvironment.

title: Vascularized tumor
desc: 3D reconstruction of a vascularized tumor model for tumor–vasculature interaction and drug penetration studies.

title: Patient-derived organoids
desc: Patient-derived organoids grown from clinical specimens (brightfield).

title: AI vessel segmentation
desc: AI-based vessel analysis: raw image (top), skeletonized network (middle) and detected sprout tips and branch points (bottom).

title: 3D cell culture platforms
desc: Examples of our microfluidic chip arrays, modular systems and well-plate-based devices.

title: Automated liquid handling on plate-format chips
desc: Standardized, plate-format Skin-on-a-Plate chips running on an automated liquid handler: liquid handling proceeds across many chips in parallel, without manual pipetting.

title: Microphysiological system plate
desc: Standardized, plate-format microphysiological system designed for automated workflows.
